## Code review checklist (Gold Standard — Ch. 3)

- [ ] Correctness verified with tests
- [ ] Unit/integration tests added or updated (coverage not reduced)
- [ ] No new function > 60 LOC without justification; no file > 800 LOC
- [ ] No magic numbers / hardcoded secrets; constants named & typed
- [ ] Error handling complete at all boundaries
- [ ] Security posture reviewed (input validation, authz, no info leak)
- [ ] Documentation / ADR updated (Definition of Done)
